/* ---- artwork constants (1280 x 1280 artwork space) --------- */
const S        = 1280;
const HORIZON  = 1005;   /* far shore / water boundary  */
const WATERL   = 1086;   /* where objects touch the water */
const STARX    = 160, STARY = 773;
const HT_PITCH = 1280/1440*4;   /* halftone dot pitch, measured */
const FPS      = 25;
const DRIFT    = 3.6;    /* grain drift, artwork px per frame */
const DRIFTMAX = 8.0;    /* encoding range of the baked drift field */
const COH      = 0.97;   /* share of the grain that travels vs re-rolls */
const STRETCH  = 2.6;    /* dash length as a multiple of the per-frame drift */
const GWIDTH   = 2.0;    /* dash width, artwork px */
const LIFE     = 3.4;    /* frames a dash keeps its value */
const BLEND    = 1.0;   /* how much a dash reads the plate as one piece */

/* ---- helpers ----------------------------------------------- */
function b64bytes(s){const b=atob(s),a=new Uint8Array(b.length);for(let i=0;i<b.length;i++)a[i]=b.charCodeAt(i);return a;}
function mulberry32(a){return function(){a|=0;a=a+0x6D2B79F5|0;let t=Math.imul(a^a>>>15,1|a);t=t+Math.imul(t^t>>>7,61|t)^t;return((t^t>>>14)>>>0)/4294967296;};}
const clamp=(v,a,b)=>v<a?a:v>b?b:v;

/* value-noise texture (periodic, cheap to sample) */
const NT=256, NTM=NT-1;
const NOISE=(function(){const r=mulberry32(9187341),a=new Float32Array(NT*NT);for(let i=0;i<NT*NT;i++)a[i]=r();return a;})();
function vnoise(x,y){
  const xi=Math.floor(x),yi=Math.floor(y),xf=x-xi,yf=y-yi;
  const u=xf*xf*(3-2*xf),v=yf*yf*(3-2*yf);
  const i0=xi&NTM,j0=yi&NTM,i1=(xi+1)&NTM,j1=(yi+1)&NTM;
  const a=NOISE[j0*NT+i0],b=NOISE[j0*NT+i1],c=NOISE[j1*NT+i0],d=NOISE[j1*NT+i1];
  return (a+(b-a)*u)+((c+(d-c)*u)-(a+(b-a)*u))*v;
}
function fbm(x,y,oct){let v=0,amp=.5,f=1;for(let i=0;i<(oct||3);i++){v+=amp*vnoise(x*f+i*37.3,y*f+i*61.7);f*=2;amp*=.5;}return v;}

/* ---- decode traced fields ---------------------------------- */
const N=64;
const _ang=b64bytes(ANG_B64), _den=b64bytes(DENS_B64);
const FC=new Float32Array(N*N), FS=new Float32Array(N*N), FD=new Float32Array(N*N);
let DMAX=0;
for(let i=0;i<N*N;i++){
  const a=_ang[i]/255*Math.PI-Math.PI/2;
  FC[i]=Math.cos(2*a); FS[i]=Math.sin(2*a); FD[i]=_den[i]/632;   /* 0.95: dashes spill a little past the filament */
  if(FD[i]>DMAX)DMAX=FD[i];
}
function fsample(arr,x,y){
  let fx=x/S*N-0.5, fy=y/S*N-0.5;
  fx=clamp(fx,0,N-1); fy=clamp(fy,0,N-1);
  const i0=fx|0,j0=fy|0,i1=Math.min(i0+1,N-1),j1=Math.min(j0+1,N-1);
  const tx=fx-i0,ty=fy-j0;
  const a=arr[j0*N+i0],b=arr[j0*N+i1],c=arr[j1*N+i0],d=arr[j1*N+i1];
  return (a+(b-a)*tx)+(((c+(d-c)*tx))-(a+(b-a)*tx))*ty;
}
const flowAngle=(x,y)=>Math.atan2(fsample(FS,x,y),fsample(FC,x,y))*0.5;
const density  =(x,y)=>fsample(FD,x,y);

/* ---- smooth closed path from a traced polygon -------------- */
function smoothPath(pts){
  const p=new Path2D(), n=pts.length;
  let mx=(pts[n-1][0]+pts[0][0])/2, my=(pts[n-1][1]+pts[0][1])/2;
  p.moveTo(mx,my);
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const c=pts[i], nx=pts[(i+1)%n];
    p.quadraticCurveTo(c[0],c[1],(c[0]+nx[0])/2,(c[1]+nx[1])/2);
  }
  p.closePath();
  return p;
}
const FACE_PATH = smoothPath(FACE_POLY);
const FIG_PATH  = smoothPath(FIG_POLY);

/* ---- hair strands ------------------------------------------ */
function buildStrands(){
  const rnd=mulberry32(20260715), out=[];
  const LOCKS=62, STEP=2.6, MAXS=520;
  let guard=0;
  while(guard<2000000){
    guard++;
    if(out.length>=LOCKS*7) break;
    const sx=rnd()*S, sy=rnd()*(WATERL+4);
    const d=density(sx,sy);
    if(d<0.0025) continue;
    if(rnd()>Math.max(0.15,Math.pow(d/DMAX,0.45))) continue;
    /* one guide streamline per lock; a constant angular bias keeps
       neighbouring locks from collapsing onto the same attractor */
    const jit=rnd()*997.0, wig=0.05+rnd()*0.16, bias=(rnd()-0.5)*0.115;
    const cb=Math.cos(bias), sb=Math.sin(bias);
    const arms=[[],[]];
    for(let dir=0;dir<2;dir++){
      let x=sx,y=sy; const sgn=dir?-1:1, a=arms[dir];
      for(let s=0;s<MAXS;s++){
        a.push(x,y);
        const th=flowAngle(x,y);
        let dx=Math.cos(th),dy=Math.sin(th);
        if(dx<0){dx=-dx;dy=-dy;}
        const ax=dx*cb-dy*sb, ay=dx*sb+dy*cb;
        const w=(fbm(x*0.0055+jit,y*0.0055+jit,3)-0.5)*wig;
        const ct=Math.cos(w),st=Math.sin(w);
        x+=(ax*ct-ay*st)*STEP*sgn; y+=(ax*st+ay*ct)*STEP*sgn;
        if(x<-40||x>S+40||y<-70||y>WATERL+22) break;
        if(density(x,y)<0.0010) break;
      }
    }
    const back=arms[1], fwd=arms[0], g=[];
    for(let i=back.length-2;i>=0;i-=2) g.push(back[i],back[i+1]);
    for(let i=2;i<fwd.length;i+=2) g.push(fwd[i],fwd[i+1]);
    const gn=g.length>>1;
    if(gn<12) continue;
    /* precompute the guide normal so the lock's filaments stay parallel */
    const nxs=new Float32Array(gn), nys=new Float32Array(gn);
    for(let i=0;i<gn;i++){
      const a=Math.max(0,i-1), b=Math.min(gn-1,i+1);
      const tx=g[b*2]-g[a*2], ty=g[b*2+1]-g[a*2+1];
      const L=Math.hypot(tx,ty)||1;
      nxs[i]=-ty/L; nys[i]=tx/L;
    }
    /* fan the guide into a lock of near-parallel filaments */
    const m=3+(rnd()*9|0), spread=2.6+rnd()*4.2, drift=(rnd()-0.5)*0.02;
    for(let f=0;f<m;f++){
      const base=(f-(m-1)/2)*spread+(rnd()-0.5)*1.6;
      const ph=rnd()*99, amp=0.30+rnd()*0.85;
      const pts=new Float64Array(gn*2);
      for(let i=0;i<gn;i++){
        const o=base*(1+amp*(fbm(i*0.035+ph,ph*0.7,2)-0.5))+drift*i;
        pts[i*2]  =g[i*2]  +nxs[i]*o;
        pts[i*2+1]=g[i*2+1]+nys[i]*o;
      }
      out.push({p:pts, k:0.25+rnd()*rnd()*2.9, w:1.05+rnd()*1.15, seed:rnd()*600});
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/* filaments rooted on the scalp: the dense radiating mane that
   frames the head in the source image                          */
function buildRoots(){
  const rnd=mulberry32(4471903), out=[], P=FACE_POLY, n=P.length;
  const cx=372, cy=772;
  for(let k=0;k<n;k++){
    const a=P[k], b=P[(k+1)%n];
    const ex=b[0]-a[0], ey=b[1]-a[1], L=Math.hypot(ex,ey);
    if(L<0.001) continue;
    const steps=Math.max(1,Math.round(L/1.1));
    let nx=-ey/L, ny=ex/L;
    const mx=(a[0]+b[0])/2, my=(a[1]+b[1])/2;
    if((mx-cx)*nx+(my-cy)*ny<0){nx=-nx;ny=-ny;}
    if(nx<0.10 && ny>-0.20) continue;                 /* face side */
    for(let t=0;t<steps;t++){
      const f=(t+rnd())/steps;
      let x=a[0]+ex*f-nx*6, y=a[1]+ey*f-ny*6;
      const len=45+Math.pow(rnd(),1.6)*430, MS=Math.round(len/2.4);
      const jit=rnd()*997, wig=0.05+rnd()*0.20, bias=(rnd()-0.5)*0.16;
      const cb=Math.cos(bias), sb=Math.sin(bias);
      const pts=[];
      for(let s2=0;s2<MS;s2++){
        pts.push(x,y);
        const th=flowAngle(x,y);
        let dx=Math.cos(th),dy=Math.sin(th);
        if(dx<0){dx=-dx;dy=-dy;}
        const ax=dx*cb-dy*sb, ay=dx*sb+dy*cb;
        const w=(fbm(x*0.006+jit,y*0.006+jit,3)-0.5)*wig;
        const ct=Math.cos(w),st=Math.sin(w);
        x+=(ax*ct-ay*st)*2.4; y+=(ax*st+ay*ct)*2.4;
        if(x<-40||x>S+40||y<-70||y>WATERL+22) break;
      }
      if(pts.length<10) continue;
      out.push({p:pts, k:0.28+rnd()*rnd()*2.0, w:0.75+rnd()*0.75, seed:rnd()*600, root:1});
    }
  }
  return out;
}

function strokeTangents(ctx,strands){
  ctx.lineCap='round'; ctx.lineJoin='round';
  const CH=5;
  for(const st of strands){
    const p=st.p, n=p.length>>1;
    for(let i=0;i<n-1;i+=CH){
      const j=Math.min(i+CH,n-1);
      let tx=p[j*2]-p[i*2], ty=p[j*2+1]-p[i*2+1];
      const L=Math.hypot(tx,ty)||1; tx/=L; ty/=L;
      if(tx<0){tx=-tx;ty=-ty;}
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(p[i*2],p[i*2+1]);
      for(let t=i+1;t<=j;t++) ctx.lineTo(p[t*2],p[t*2+1]);
      ctx.lineWidth=Math.max(2.6,st.w*2.2);
      ctx.strokeStyle='rgb('+Math.round((tx*0.5+0.5)*255)+','+Math.round((ty*0.5+0.5)*255)+',255)';
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }
}

function strokeStrands(ctx,strands,style){
  ctx.lineCap='round'; ctx.lineJoin='round';
  const CH=5;
  for(let si=0;si<strands.length;si++){
    const st=strands[si], p=st.p, n=p.length>>1;
    if(style.every && (si%style.every)) continue;
    for(let i=0;i<n-1;i+=CH){
      const j=Math.min(i+CH,n-1), m=(i+j)>>1;
      const mx=p[m*2], my=p[m*2+1];
      let a=density(mx,my)/DMAX;
      a=Math.pow(clamp(a,0,1),0.45)*st.k;
      /* filaments read as bright dashes with dark gaps, not even lines */
      const gg=clamp((fbm(mx*0.045+st.seed,my*0.045,3)-0.34)*2.6,0,1);
      a*= 0.62+1.25*gg;
      if(style.zone && !st.root){
        /* long filaments thin out near the scalp so the rooted
           mane carries the tone budget there */
        const ex=(mx-380)/300, ey=(my-762)/370;
        const r=Math.sqrt(ex*ex+ey*ey);
        a*= 0.10+0.90*clamp((r-0.5)/0.8,0,1);
      }
      if(st.root){                       /* ease in from the scalp */
        const f=i/n;
        a*=0.32+0.68*clamp(f*3.2,0,1);
        a*=clamp((1-f)*2.6,0.12,1);
      }
      if(style.fade) a*=style.fade(mx,my);
      a*= style.gain;
      if(a<0.003) continue;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(p[i*2],p[i*2+1]);
      for(let t=i+1;t<=j;t++) ctx.lineTo(p[t*2],p[t*2+1]);
      ctx.lineWidth=st.w*style.wmul;
      ctx.strokeStyle=style.color+Math.min(a,1).toFixed(3)+')';
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }
}

/* ---- star -------------------------------------------------- */
const SPIKES=[
  [-88,196,1.1],[ 92,250,1.2],[180,118,1.3],[  3,100,1.3],
  [-47,122,2.1],[-33,102,1.9],[-62, 98,1.9],[-20, 72,1.4],[-72, 70,1.4],
  [ 25,112,2.1],[ 42,110,2.0],[ 60, 78,1.5],[ 12, 58,1.3],[ 74, 54,1.2],
  [-160,112,2.1],[-145,110,2.0],[-128,94,1.7],[-172,68,1.3],[-110,53,1.2],
  [ 118, 98,1.7],[ 135,114,2.0],[ 152,106,2.0],[ 105,57,1.2],[ 166,57,1.2]
];
function drawStar(ctx){
  ctx.save(); ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
  let g=ctx.createRadialGradient(STARX,STARY,0,STARX,STARY,44);
  g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,255,255,0.10)');
  g.addColorStop(0.12,'rgba(255,255,255,0.050)');
  g.addColorStop(0.42,'rgba(255,255,255,0.007)');
  g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(STARX,STARY,44,0,7); ctx.fill();
  for(const[deg,len,w] of SPIKES){
    const a=deg*Math.PI/180;
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(STARX,STARY); ctx.rotate(a);
    const lg=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,len,0);
    lg.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,255,255,1)');
    lg.addColorStop(0.07,'rgba(255,255,255,0.62)');
    lg.addColorStop(0.34,'rgba(255,255,255,0.20)');
    lg.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle=lg;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,-w); ctx.lineTo(len,0); ctx.lineTo(0,w); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }
  g=ctx.createRadialGradient(STARX,STARY,0,STARX,STARY,22);
  g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,255,255,1)');
  g.addColorStop(0.30,'rgba(255,255,255,0.95)');
  g.addColorStop(0.62,'rgba(255,255,255,0.45)');
  g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(STARX,STARY,22,0,7); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

/* ---- face detail strokes ----------------------------------- */
function drawFaceDetail(ctx){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.clip(FACE_PATH);
  ctx.lineCap='round'; ctx.lineJoin='round';
  const blob=(x,y,rx,ry,rot,a)=>{
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(x,y); ctx.rotate(rot); ctx.scale(rx,ry);
    const g=ctx.createRadialGradient(0,0,0,0,0,1);
    g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(0,0,0,'+a+')');
    g.addColorStop(0.55,'rgba(0,0,0,'+(a*0.55)+')');
    g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,1,0,7); ctx.fill(); ctx.restore();
  };
  const line=(pts,w,a)=>{
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pts[0][0],pts[0][1]);

/* ---------- tone-match the hair layer to the traced field --- */
function normaliseHair(){
  const img=hctx.getImageData(0,0,BW,BH), D=img.data;
  const sum=new Float64Array(N*N), cnt=new Float64Array(N*N);
  const inv=N/S;
  for(let y=0;y<BH;y++){
    const ay=y-OY; if(ay<0||ay>=S) continue;
    const j=Math.min(N-1,(ay*inv)|0);
    for(let x=0;x<BW;x++){
      const ax=x-OX; if(ax<0||ax>=S) continue;
      const i=Math.min(N-1,(ax*inv)|0);
      sum[j*N+i]+=D[(y*BW+x)<<2]; cnt[j*N+i]++;
    }
  }
  const gainF=new Float32Array(N*N);
  for(let k=0;k<N*N;k++){
    const mine=cnt[k]?sum[k]/cnt[k]/255:0;
    gainF[k]=clamp(FD[k]/(mine+1e-4),0.12,6.0);
  }
  for(let y=0;y<BH;y++){
    const ay=y-OY;
    for(let x=0;x<BW;x++){
      const i=(y*BW+x)<<2;
      const v=D[i]; if(!v) continue;
      const g=fsample(gainF,clamp(x-OX,0,S-1),clamp(ay,0,S-1));
      const nv=v*g;
      D[i]=D[i+1]=D[i+2]=nv>255?255:nv;
    }
  }
  hctx.putImageData(img,0,0);
}

/* ---------- per-pixel: halftone, shore, water -------------- */
function pixelPass(){
  const img=bctx.getImageData(0,0,BW,BH), D=img.data;
  const M=mctx.getImageData(0,0,BW,BH).data;
  const T=dctx.getImageData(0,0,BW,BH).data;
  const kx=2*Math.PI/HT_PITCH;

  /* dot screen over skin: a square lattice at the measured pitch,
     dot area following the local tone, phase-locked to the dither grid */
  const HTQ=HT_PITCH*0.25;
  for(let y=0;y<BH;y++){
    const ay=y-OY+HTQ;
    for(let x=0;x<BW;x++){
      const i=(y*BW+x)<<2;
      const m=M[i]/255;
      if(m<=0.004) continue;
      const ax=x-OX+HTQ;
      let v=D[i]/255;
      v*=1+m*0.52*(fbm(ax*0.032,ay*0.032,3)-0.5);
      const px=ax/HT_PITCH, py=ay/HT_PITCH;
      const fx=px-Math.round(px), fy=py-Math.round(py);
      const d=Math.sqrt(fx*fx+fy*fy)*2;
      const r=Math.sqrt(clamp(v,0,1))*1.12;
      const dot=clamp((r-d)/0.38+0.5,0,1);
      v=clamp(v+m*0.66*(dot-v),0,1);
      D[i]=D[i+1]=D[i+2]=v*255;
    }
  }

  /* far shore band + horizon glint */
  const y0=Math.round(OY+HORIZON-78), y1=Math.round(OY+HORIZON);
  for(let y=y0;y<=y1+1;y++){
    if(y<0||y>=BH) continue;
    const ay=y-OY, t=(ay-(HORIZON-78))/78;
    for(let x=0;x<BW;x++){
      const ax=x-OX;
      const lat=clamp(1.30-Math.abs(ax-300)/560,0.0,1);
      let n=fbm(ax*0.30,ay*0.85,3);
      let v=Math.pow(Math.max(0,n-0.44),1.5)*2.9*(0.18+0.90*t)*lat*0.125;
      if(ay>HORIZON-5) v+= (0.05+0.30*Math.pow(fbm(ax*0.09,7.3,3),1.6))*lat*Math.max(0,1-Math.abs(ay-(HORIZON-2))/3.2)*0.34;
      if(v<=0) continue;
      const i=(y*BW+x)<<2;
      const nv=Math.min(255,D[i]+v*255);
      D[i]=D[i+1]=D[i+2]=nv;
    }
  }

  /* water: the scene mirrored about the contact line, then sliced
     into perspective ripple dashes                                  */
  const RC=0.95, wl=OY+WATERL;
  for(let y=Math.round(wl);y<BH;y++){
    const dep=y-wl;
    const ys=wl-dep*RC;
    const yw=Math.pow(dep+2,0.56)*2.15;
    const fade=0.38+0.95*clamp(dep/320,0,1);
    for(let x=0;x<BW;x++){
      const hard=clamp((dep-6)/130,0,1);
      const ph=fbm(x*0.0060,yw*0.09,3)*8.0+fbm(x*0.030,yw*0.22+17.0,2)*3.4
              +fbm(x*0.095,yw*0.55+91.0,2)*2.2;
      const w1=Math.sin(yw*4.70+ph);
      const w2=Math.sin(yw*1.85+fbm(x*0.0021,yw*0.05+40.0,2)*7.0+1.7);
      /* near the contact the surface is a near-mirror sliced by wave
         crests; further out it breaks into drawn-out speckle          */
      const crest=clamp((w1*0.58+w2*0.44)+0.80,0,1.3);
      const speck=clamp(Math.pow(fbm(x*0.030,yw*2.30+31.0,3),1.05)*3.4-1.02,0,1.2)
                 *(0.32+0.95*fbm(x*0.010,yw*0.70+77.0,2));
      let rip=crest*(1-hard)+speck*hard*0.26;
      if(rip<=0.006) continue;
      const dx=(fbm(x*0.0085,yw*0.16+11.0,2)-0.5)*22.0;
      const dy=(fbm(x*0.0120,yw*0.26+53.0,2)-0.5)*9.0;
      const sy=Math.round(ys+dy);
      if(sy<0||sy>=BH) continue;
      let v=0, nsm=0;
      for(let k=-2;k<=2;k++){
        const sx=Math.round(x+dx+k*1.6);
        if(sx<0||sx>=BW) continue;
        v+=D[(sy*BW+sx)<<2]; nsm++;
      }
      if(!nsm) continue;
      v=v/nsm/255;
      if(v>0.40) v=0.40+(v-0.40)*0.30;   /* water never mirrors a highlight */
      /* the surface also catches its own light, far from any reflection */
      v+=0.22*Math.pow(clamp((dep-52)/240,0,1),1.35)
           *(0.35+1.05*fbm(x*0.0075,yw*0.14+5.0,2));
      const i=(y*BW+x)<<2;
      const nv=D[i]+v*rip*fade*2.3*255;
      D[i]=D[i+1]=D[i+2]=nv>255?255:nv;
    }
  }
  /* the shelf of distant water above the contact line stays almost dark */
  for(let y=Math.round(OY+HORIZON)+2;y<Math.round(wl);y++){
    const ay=y-OY, t=(ay-HORIZON)/(WATERL-HORIZON);
    for(let x=0;x<BW;x++){
      const g=Math.pow(fbm(x*0.16,ay*0.75+9.0,3),4.5)*3.0*(0.15+0.85*t);
      if(g<=0.004) continue;
      const i=(y*BW+x)<<2;
      const nv=D[i]+g*7;
      D[i]=D[i+1]=D[i+2]=nv>255?255:nv;
    }
  }
  /* G,B carry the per-pixel drift the grain is advected along:
     outward through the hair, level across the water, nearly still
     on skin — measured off the source, ~3.5 artwork px per frame  */
  for(let y=0;y<BH;y++){
    const ay=y-OY;
    for(let x=0;x<BW;x++){
      const i=(y*BW+x)<<2;
      const ax=x-OX;
      let fx,fy;
      if(T[i+2]>150){                                 /* on a filament */
        fx=T[i]/255*2-1; fy=T[i+1]/255*2-1;
        const L=Math.hypot(fx,fy)||1; fx/=L; fy/=L;
      }else{
        const th=flowAngle(clamp(ax,0,S-1),clamp(ay,0,S-1));
        fx=Math.cos(th); fy=Math.sin(th);
        if(fx<0){fx=-fx;fy=-fy;}
      }
      let sp=DRIFT;
      if(ay>HORIZON) sp*=0.55;                       /* water runs slower */
      sp*=1-0.72*(M[i]/255);                         /* skin barely moves */
      D[i+1]=clamp(fx*sp/DRIFTMAX*0.5+0.5,0,1)*255;
      D[i+2]=clamp(fy*sp/DRIFTMAX*0.5+0.5,0,1)*255;
    }
  }
  bctx.putImageData(img,0,0);
}

/* ---------- gl dither ------------------------------------- */
const VS=`attribute vec2 p;void main(){gl_Position=vec4(p,0.,1.);}`;
/* the plate is thresholded against fresh noise every frame on a grid
   of DCELL artwork pixels — the cell size measured off the source     */
const FS_=`precision highp float;
uniform sampler2D uBase;uniform vec2 uSize;
uniform vec2 uTrans;
uniform float uUnit,uSeed,uTime,uDriftMax,uCoh,uStretch,uWidth,uLife,uBlend;
const float DGRAIN=1280.0/1440.0;
float hash(vec3 p){p=fract(p*vec3(443.8975,441.4232,437.1951));p+=dot(p,p.yzx+19.19);return fract((p.x+p.y)*p.z);}
void main(){
  float DCELL=max(DGRAIN,1.0/uUnit);
  vec2 fc=gl_FragCoord.xy-uTrans;
  if(fc.x<0.0||fc.y<0.0||fc.x>=uSize.x*uUnit||fc.y>=uSize.y*uUnit){
    gl_FragColor=vec4(0.0,0.0,0.0,1.0); return;   /* outside the plate */
  }
  vec2 cell=floor(fc/(uUnit*DCELL));
  vec2 c=(cell+0.5)*DCELL, o=vec2(0.30*DCELL);
  float v=0.25*(texture2D(uBase,vec2(c.x-o.x,uSize.y-c.y+o.y)/uSize).r
               +texture2D(uBase,vec2(c.x+o.x,uSize.y-c.y+o.y)/uSize).r
               +texture2D(uBase,vec2(c.x-o.x,uSize.y-c.y-o.y)/uSize).r
               +texture2D(uBase,vec2(c.x+o.x,uSize.y-c.y-o.y)/uSize).r);

  /* The grain is neither isotropic nor still. The threshold field is
     quantised into cells stretched along the local drift, so a lit cell
     reads as a dash lying down the strand, and the field slides along
     its own axis — which makes advection a pure 1-D translation and
     sidesteps the shear a 2-D flow map accumulates. A dash is thresholded
     against the plate sampled along its own length from its own centre,
     so it lights as one piece; cells that are not travelling fall back to
     per-pixel noise, which is what fills the space between the dashes. */
  vec2 ap=vec2(c.x,uSize.y-c.y);                    /* artwork px, y down */
  vec2 dr=(texture2D(uBase,ap/uSize).gb*2.0-1.0)*uDriftMax;
  /* the cell axes must be piecewise constant: dotting a ~1000px position
     with a smoothly varying direction turns a 0.002 wobble into a whole
     cell of jitter, which shatters every dash into single pixels        */
  float sp=floor(length(dr)*3.0+0.5)/3.0;
  float aa=floor(atan(dr.y,dr.x)*11.5+0.5)/11.5;
  vec2 tg=vec2(cos(aa),sin(aa)), pp=vec2(-tg.y,tg.x);
  float len=max(2.0,sp*uStretch), wid=uWidth;
  vec2 sc=floor(vec2((dot(ap,tg)-uTime*sp)/len, dot(ap,pp)/wid));
  float ep=floor(uTime/uLife+hash(vec3(sc,3.0)));   /* staggered rebirth */

  float n;
  float coh=uCoh*clamp((sp-1.2)/1.6,0.0,1.0);   /* skin keeps its dot screen */
  if(hash(vec3(sc+vec2(37.3,91.7),ep*2.7+5.0))<coh){
    vec2 ctr=tg*((sc.x+0.5)*len+uTime*sp)+pp*((sc.y+0.5)*wid);
    vec2 st=tg*len;
    float vd=0.2*(texture2D(uBase,(ctr-st*0.40)/uSize).r
                 +texture2D(uBase,(ctr-st*0.20)/uSize).r
                 +texture2D(uBase, ctr          /uSize).r
                 +texture2D(uBase,(ctr+st*0.20)/uSize).r
                 +texture2D(uBase,(ctr+st*0.40)/uSize).r);
    v=mix(v,vd,uBlend);
    n=hash(vec3(sc,ep*1.9+17.0));
  }else{
    n=hash(vec3(cell,uSeed));
  }
  gl_FragColor=vec4(vec3(v>n&&v>0.0?1.0:0.0),1.0);
}`;
function sh(t,s){const o=gl.createShader(t);gl.shaderSource(o,s);gl.compileShader(o);
  if(!gl.getShaderParameter(o,gl.COMPILE_STATUS))console.error(gl.getShaderInfoLog(o));return o;}
function initGL(){
  prog=gl.createProgram();
  gl.attachShader(prog,sh(gl.VERTEX_SHADER,VS));
  gl.attachShader(prog,sh(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER,FS_));
  gl.linkProgram(prog); gl.useProgram(prog);
  const b=gl.createBuffer(); gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,b);
  gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,new Float32Array([-1,-1,3,-1,-1,3]),gl.STATIC_DRAW);
  const loc=gl.getAttribLocation(prog,'p');
  gl.enableVertexAttribArray(loc); gl.vertexAttribPointer(loc,2,gl.FLOAT,false,0,0);
  uni.base=gl.getUniformLocation(prog,'uBase');
  uni.size=gl.getUniformLocation(prog,'uSize');
  uni.unit=gl.getUniformLocation(prog,'uUnit');
  uni.trans=gl.getUniformLocation(prog,'uTrans');
  uni.seed=gl.getUniformLocation(prog,'uSeed');
  uni.time=gl.getUniformLocation(prog,'uTime');
  gl.uniform1f(gl.getUniformLocation(prog,'uDriftMax'),DRIFTMAX);
  gl.uniform1f(gl.getUniformLocation(prog,'uCoh'),COH);
  gl.uniform1f(gl.getUniformLocation(prog,'uStretch'),STRETCH);
  gl.uniform1f(gl.getUniformLocation(prog,'uWidth'),GWIDTH);
  gl.uniform1f(gl.getUniformLocation(prog,'uLife'),LIFE);
  gl.uniform1f(gl.getUniformLocation(prog,'uBlend'),BLEND);
  tex=gl.createTexture();
  gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D,tex);
  gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER,gl.LINEAR);
  gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER,gl.LINEAR);
  gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S,gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
  gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T,gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
  gl.uniform1i(uni.base,0);
}
function upload(){
  gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D,tex);
  gl.pixelStorei(gl.UNPACK_FLIP_Y_WEBGL,false);
  gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D,0,gl.RGBA,gl.RGBA,gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,base);
}

/* ---------- layout ------------------------------------------
   Two halves. fitCanvas only matches the drawing buffer to the window
   and re-centres the plate at a single uniform scale — it runs on every
   resize event, so the picture is never stretched to fit a stale buffer.
   Rebuilding the plate is the expensive half and stays debounced.      */
function fitCanvas(){
  const dpr=Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,2);
  const W=Math.max(1,Math.round(innerWidth*dpr)), H=Math.max(1,Math.round(innerHeight*dpr));
  if(!W||!H) return;
  if(view.width!==W||view.height!==H){ view.width=W; view.height=H; }
  const u=Math.min(W,H)/S;                       /* the square stays square */
  if(!gl){
    fallback.fillStyle='#000'; fallback.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    fallback.imageSmoothingEnabled=true;
    fallback.drawImage(base,Math.round((W-BW*u)/2),Math.round((H-BH*u)/2),BW*u,BH*u);
    return;
  }
  gl.viewport(0,0,W,H);
  gl.uniform1f(uni.unit,u);
  gl.uniform2f(uni.trans,(W-BW*u)/2,(H-BH*u)/2);

  band(x,spine(0.14,0.02,2.4,-0.2),'rgba(120,190,255,0.4)',0.03,0.02,1);
  x.save();
  x.beginPath(); x.moveTo(0,TS*0.72); x.lineTo(TS,TS*0.4); x.lineTo(TS,TS); x.lineTo(0,TS); x.closePath();
  x.clip();
  fill(x, lin(x,0.1,0.4,0.6,1,[[0,'#c6c7cd'],[0.5,'#e2e2e6'],[1,'#f2f2f4']]));
  x.restore();
}
];

function roundRectPath(x,w,h,r){
  x.beginPath();
  x.moveTo(-w/2+r,-h/2);
  x.lineTo(w/2-r,-h/2); x.quadraticCurveTo(w/2,-h/2,w/2,-h/2+r);
  x.lineTo(w/2,h/2-r);  x.quadraticCurveTo(w/2,h/2,w/2-r,h/2);
  x.lineTo(-w/2+r,h/2); x.quadraticCurveTo(-w/2,h/2,-w/2,h/2-r);
  x.lineTo(-w/2,-h/2+r);x.quadraticCurveTo(-w/2,-h/2,-w/2+r,-h/2);
  x.closePath();
}

function buildTextures(){
  var front = [], back = [];
  for (var i=0;i<ART.length;i++){
    var c = mkc(TS,TS), x = c.getContext('2d');
    ART[i](x);
    /* film grain */
    x.save();
    x.globalCompositeOperation = 'overlay';
    x.globalAlpha = 0.15;
    var p = x.createPattern(grainTile,'repeat');
    x.fillStyle = p; x.fillRect(0,0,TS,TS);
    x.restore();
    front.push(c);

    /* reverse side: darker and washed out */
    var d = mkc(TS,TS), y = d.getContext('2d');
    y.drawImage(c,0,0);
    y.globalCompositeOperation = 'saturation';
    y.fillStyle = 'rgba(128,128,128,0.2)'; y.fillRect(0,0,TS,TS);
    y.globalCompositeOperation = 'multiply';
    y.fillStyle = 'rgba(6,8,18,0.75)'; y.fillRect(0,0,TS,TS);
    back.push(d);
  }
  return { front: front, back: back };
}
var TEX = buildTextures();

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *
 * Ring geometry.  u / v span the ring plane; z points at the viewer.
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
var ax = RING.axis * Math.PI/180, cf = RING.ratio, sf = Math.sqrt(1-cf*cf);
var U = [Math.cos(ax), Math.sin(ax), 0];
var V = [-Math.sin(ax)*cf, Math.cos(ax)*cf, sf];
var AXIS = [                                    /* U x V — the ring's own axis */
  U[1]*V[2]-U[2]*V[1],
  U[2]*V[0]-U[0]*V[2],
  U[0]*V[1]-U[1]*V[0]
];

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *
 * Canvas + layout
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
var cv = document.getElementById('stage'), ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
var W = 0, H = 0, K = 1, OX = 0, OY = 0, headLayer = null, labelLayer = null;

function d2sx(x){ return OX + x*K; }
function d2sy(y){ return OY + y*K; }

/* draw text whose inked box matches a target: capHeight and (optional) width */
function fitText(x,str,font,weight,cap,cx,capTop,targetW,color,align){
  var probe = 100;
  x.font = weight+' '+probe+'px '+font;
  var m = x.measureText('H');
  var capUnit = (m.actualBoundingBoxAscent||71) / probe;
  var size = cap / capUnit;
  x.font = weight+' '+size+'px '+font;
  var mm = x.measureText(str);
  var inkW = (mm.actualBoundingBoxRight||mm.width) + (mm.actualBoundingBoxLeft||0);
  var sx = targetW ? targetW / inkW : 1;
  x.save();
  x.fillStyle = color;
  x.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
  x.translate(cx, capTop + cap);
  x.scale(sx,1);
  x.textAlign = align || 'center';
  var left = (mm.actualBoundingBoxLeft||0);
  x.fillText(str, align === 'left' ? left : 0, 0);
  x.restore();
  return inkW*sx;
}

function buildHead(){
  headLayer = mkc(Math.max(1,W), Math.max(1,H));
  var x = headLayer.getContext('2d');
  for (var i=0;i<HEAD.length;i++){
    var h = HEAD[i];
    fitText(x, h.s, SANS, '700', CAP*K, d2sx(1481), d2sy(h.top), h.w*K, h.fill);
  }
}

function buildLabels(){
  labelLayer = mkc(Math.max(1,W), Math.max(1,H));
  var x = labelLayer.getContext('2d');
  var cap = SMALL*K, dim = '#b0b0b0', pad = 88*K;
  /* corner marks hug the viewport so the frame reads at any aspect */
  x.save();
  x.fillStyle = dim; x.textBaseline = 'alphabetic'; x.textAlign = 'left';
  var f = '400 ' + (cap/0.717) + 'px ' + SANS;
  x.font = f;
  if (x.letterSpacing !== undefined) x.letterSpacing = (0.03*cap)+'px';
  x.fillText('VOID BLUE   /   GRADIENT STRIPS   /   RED AURA', pad, pad + cap);
  x.fillText('2026', pad, H - pad);
  x.textAlign = 'right';
  x.fillText('GRAINIENT.SUPPLY', W - pad, H - pad);
  x.restore();

  /* the two notes flanking the headline sit with the ring */
  var pitch = 33*K;
  var L = ['(50+) Gradients','Backgrounds','Added,'];
  for (var i=0;i<L.length;i++)
    fitText(x, L[i], SANS, '500', cap, d2sx(344), d2sy(1148) + i*pitch, 0, '#ffffff', 'left');
  var Rt = ['Gradients &','AI-Generated','Backgrounds'];
  for (var j=0;j<Rt.length;j++)
    fitText(x, Rt[j], SANS, '500', cap, d2sx(2310), d2sy(932) + j*32.5*K, 0, '#ffffff', 'left');
}

function resize(){
  var dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
  W = Math.round(window.innerWidth * dpr);
  H = Math.round(window.innerHeight * dpr);
  cv.width = W; cv.height = H;
  var S = Math.min(W, H*DASP);           /* effective design width */
  K = S / DW;
  OX = (W - DW*K)/2;
  OY = (H - DH*K)/2;
  buildHead();
  buildLabels();
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *
 * Frame
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
function project(p){
  var k = RING.a*K*RING.dist / (RING.dist - p[2]);
  return [ d2sx(RING.cx) + k*p[0], d2sy(RING.cy) + k*p[1], k ];
}

function drawTile(i, psi){
  var c = Math.cos(psi), s = Math.sin(psi);
  var C  = [c*U[0]+s*V[0], c*U[1]+s*V[1], c*U[2]+s*V[2]];      /* centre, |C| = 1 */
  var T  = [-s*U[0]+c*V[0], -s*U[1]+c*V[1], -s*U[2]+c*V[2]];   /* tangent          */
  var h  = RING.tile/(2*RING.a);                               /* half side, ring units */
  var p0 = project(C);
  var pT = project([C[0]+T[0]*h, C[1]+T[1]*h, C[2]+T[2]*h]);
  var pA = project([C[0]+AXIS[0]*h, C[1]+AXIS[1]*h, C[2]+AXIS[2]*h]);
  var ex = pT[0]-p0[0], ey = pT[1]-p0[1];
  var fx = pA[0]-p0[0], fy = pA[1]-p0[1];
  if (Math.abs(ex*fy - ey*fx) < 0.4) return;                   /* edge on */

  var facing = C[2] > 0;                                       /* radial normal ~ C */
  var img = (facing ? TEX.front : TEX.back)[i % TEX.front.length];
  ctx.save();
  ctx.setTransform(ex*2/TS, ey*2/TS, fx*2/TS, fy*2/TS, p0[0], p0[1]);
  roundRectPath(ctx, TS, TS, TS*RING.radius);
  ctx.clip();
  ctx.drawImage(img, -TS/2, -TS/2, TS, TS);
  ctx.restore();
  ctx.setTransform(1,0,0,1,0,0);
}

function render(t){
  ctx.setTransform(1,0,0,1,0,0);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.imageSmoothingQuality = 'high';

  var spin = (t/DUR)*Math.PI*2;
  var list = [], i;
  for (i=0;i<RING.n;i++){
    var psi = RING.phase*Math.PI/180 - i*2*Math.PI/RING.n + spin;
    var c = Math.cos(psi), s = Math.sin(psi);
    list.push({ i:i, psi:psi, z: c*U[2] + s*V[2] });
  }
  list.sort(function(a,b){ return a.z - b.z; });

  var drawnText = false;
  for (i=0;i<list.length;i++){
    if (!drawnText && list[i].z > 0){ ctx.drawImage(headLayer,0,0); drawnText = true; }
    drawTile(list[i].i, list[i].psi);
  }
  if (!drawnText) ctx.drawImage(headLayer,0,0);
  ctx.drawImage(labelLayer,0,0);
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *
 * Clock + public controls
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
var t0 = performance.now(), tNow = 0, playing = true;

function frame(now){
  if (playing){
    tNow = ((now - t0)/1000) % DUR;
    render(tNow);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}

window.addEventListener('resize', function(){ resize(); render(tNow); });
resize();
requestAnimationFrame(frame);

window.__DUR = DUR;
window.__seek = function(t){
  tNow = ((t % DUR) + DUR) % DUR;
  playing = false;
  render(tNow);
};
window.__play = function(){ t0 = performance.now() - tNow*1000; playing = true; };
window.__pause = function(){ playing = false; };
window.__time = function(){ return tNow; };
})();
